properties.description: The cut that completes GitHub issue #616. Cut overnight on Anthony's word in the dev_reflow2 hub session, 2026-10-01: "merge the PRs as needed. when ready, deploy to flo2.io … you have my approval to act autonomously throughout the night to finish up the oauth 2.1 tasks". Contents, by PR: #641 a capture that replaces a node says so, and distinct_from is kept; #642 the served text keeps the reader's lens out of the design; #620 a server whose design is held by another process serves it in place when that process lets go, and /readyz says whether the design is served (#616 fix 3); #640 understated_status; #643 an exposed server verifies OAuth bearer tokens itself (#616 fix 4, the resource-server half); and #644, the design record that folded the 2026-09-30/10-01 live records into main before this cut. The schema stamp does not move (28 node types, 66 edge types; distinct_from is an additive property), so no upgrade note is owed. Sequence 655 places it after epoch:v0750-cut (654) and before the planned milestones from 656.
